standard_prerequisites.use: First order thickenings over a base algebraic space, conormal sheaves with their square-zero structure, and differentials of the morphisms; the construction is retained.

core_obligations: Use the conormal sheaf's square-zero structure to construct the modified structure-sheaf map determined by the given derivation datum.
Verify the modified map is a morphism of thickenings over B, and prove uniqueness by comparing two candidates through their difference.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the thickening morphism and the linear map of differentials to the conormal sheaf.
Construct the modified map on structure sheaves using square-zero.
Prove it is a morphism of thickenings over B and that it is unique.

difficulty_reason: For a morphism of first order thickenings of algebraic spaces over a base algebraic space B and a linear map from the pullback of the differentials to the conormal sheaf, the lemma produces a unique morphism of the thickening pairs obtained by acting with the derivation, and identifies its effect on the structure sheaves. The proof uses the square-zero structure of the conormal sheaf to define the modified map on structure sheaves, verifies the resulting map is a morphism of thickenings over B by checking the algebra structure, and proves uniqueness by comparing two such maps through the difference construction. The construction and its uniqueness via the difference are the substance. Retained author proof at lines 3764-3800.
